_about: Machine-readable rules semantics used to derive answers consistently. Every consequence cites the rules file it comes from. Hand-encoded from rules/magic-states-effects/*.md and reviewed.

cursed.label: Cursed
cursed.summary: Immune to Spirit; persists after death, removed on respawn.

frozen.label: Frozen
frozen.summary: May not move, speak or take any action; unaffected by combat and abilities except those that work on States in general or on Frozen.

insubstantial.label: Insubstantial
insubstantial.summary: Cannot interact with players, items or objectives; may not move from the starting location unless the ability allows; unaffected by combat and abilities except those that work on States in general or on Insubstantial; may use Meta-Magic and Charge; may exit by incanting if they caused it.

consequences.prevents_casting: may only target themselves with abilities that affect Insubstantial players; may use Meta-Magic and Charge
consequences.exit_incantation: I return to the physical world x2 (if they caused it and it is not from an Enchantment)

invulnerable.label: Invulnerable
invulnerable.summary: Unaffected by combat and abilities that do not specifically work on Invulnerable players; cannot interact; cannot be an alternate base or respawn.

consequences.prevents_casting: only abilities that specifically allow it

stopped.label: Stopped
stopped.summary: May not move their feet; Forced Movement cast on them fails.

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.summary: May not move, speak or take any action voluntarily; may still be forced to move to a specific destination (Shove, Banish).

suppressed.label: Suppressed
suppressed.summary: Unable to cast abilities or use the Charge incantation; does not stop abilities already cast, Chants in progress or Enchantments activating.

rules: A player can have any number of different States at once.
States conferred by a class Trait are always on and cannot be removed by respawn, death or any other means.
Gaining a State already held only extends it if the new duration is longer.
Unless otherwise noted, States cannot apply to dead players and are removed when a player dies or avoids death through Troll Blood, Phoenix Tears or Song of Survival.
When a State that prevented movement expires, the player declares 'No longer [State]' audibly to 20'.

derived_capabilities._about: Moved to scripts/meta_vocab.py CAPABILITIES (label and exact rule), which the build, query tool and explorer share.

special_effects._about: rules/magic-states-effects/special-effects.md. Special Effects granted to weapons and arrows are always Extraordinary; they have no School except Wounds Kill (Death).

armor-breaking.label: Armor Breaking
armor-breaking.summary: An armor location with 3 or fewer points drops to 0; otherwise a normal hit.

armor-destroying.label: Armor Destroying
armor-destroying.summary: The armor location drops to 0 points.

phasing.label: Phasing
phasing.summary: Hits and their Special Effects ignore ongoing abilities and Traits (not States).

shield-crushing.label: Shield Crushing
shield-crushing.summary: The shield is damaged; three cumulative damages destroy it.

siege.label: Siege
siege.summary: A strike kills the player and destroys all their carried equipment.

wounds-kill.label: Wounds Kill
wounds-kill.summary: A player wounded by it dies. Always Death School.

mechanics._about: Short definitions with their source anchors in rules/magic-states-effects/mechanics-and-definitions.md (unless stated).
mechanics.ability-order: Traits, then Immunities, then Resistances, then other Enchantments; other Enchantments trigger at the same time.
mechanics.alternate-base: Can be used as a base only for Forced Movement to base, not for exiting Sanctuary or Reload or repairing; works while the player is Dead, Frozen or Insubstantial.
mechanics.archetype: Class options marked (A), always active, not Enchantments, cannot be removed.
mechanics.chant: Audible, at most 5 seconds apart, heard to 50'; stopping ends the effect; may be spoken while moving; one Chant at a time.
mechanics.charge: Regain a use with the Charge Incantation repeated N times, with an empty hand and feet still.
mechanics.empty-hand: Not touching a shield (except incidental small shield), a weapon other than an unbroken Magic Staff, arrows, or game objectives.
mechanics.enchantments: Ongoing abilities worn by players; one Magical Enchantment at a time; only on willing players; Immunities do not prevent them; inactive while dead; removed on respawn unless Persistent.
mechanics.engulfing: Affects the target if it strikes a valid hit location, garb or carried equipment.
mechanics.forced-movement: Fails if cast on a Stopped player; Enchantment-triggered movement is still allowed; the player may drag a wounded leg.
mechanics.immune: Unaffected by abilities of a School; does not protect equipment unless noted; does not remove existing effects.
mechanics.incantation: The spoken part of an ability; see Casting Abilities for requirements.
mechanics.magic-armor: Only the highest source counts; repairable; covers all locations; fails on players wearing armor; not enhanced by Ancestral or Harden Armor unless inherent.
mechanics.magic-balls: Must be held at the end of the incantation; one active at a time; Engulfing affects on any valid hit; not stopped by Protection from Projectiles or Song of Deflection.
mechanics.meta-magic: Stated before the modified ability's incantation; expended when stated; cannot modify Magic Items or abilities granted by Enchantments.
mechanics.ongoing-effects: Effects with a duration (definite or indefinite); removed when the player dies unless noted.
mechanics.range: Self; Other (another player at Touch); Touch (self or other, by contact or within six inches); 20'; 50'. Touch needs the target willing, dead, Stunned, Frozen or immobile Insubstantial.
mechanics.resistant: Unaffected by the next effect of a type: wounds, a School, or a whole source.
mechanics.school: Command, Death, Flame, Neutral, Protection, Sorcery, Spirit, Subdual.
mechanics.specialty-arrows: Fired alone; incanted immediately before firing; not interrupted by moving the feet; count as a normal arrow hit plus their effect.
mechanics.traits: Always on, cannot be removed, persist through death and respawn, do not count towards Enchantment limits.
mechanics.trigger: Kill Trigger: within 30 seconds of a killing blow, outside 10' of living enemies, one per kill. Wound Trigger: immediately after wounding an enemy.
mechanics.verbal: Abilities that need only an incantation.
mechanics.persistent: An Enchantment that returns with the bearer after respawning.
mechanics.respawn: Returning to play at a base after death (battlegame rules).
mechanics.refresh: When per-Refresh abilities are restored (battlegame rules).
mechanics.look-the-part: A game-by-game bonus ability for visually impressive garb (rules/classes/_overview.md).
mechanics.enchantment-limit: The number of Enchantments a player may wear (one Magical Enchantment unless another ability allows more).
mechanics.declaration: Something said aloud that is not an incantation (not stopped by Suppressed, may be said while moving).
mechanics.strips: Enchantment strips worn to show an Enchantment and track its uses.
mechanics.game-objectives: Items and objectives in a battlegame.
